problem_and_intended_users_defined.rationale: The product documentation defines the exact-source release automation problem and maintainer/operator audience, and explicitly distinguishes the toolkit from version/changelog/package automation.

public_repository_or_distribution_surfac.rationale: The reusable Action is publicly distributed in the repository and the exact product source is published as v0.2.0.

explicit_open_source_license.rationale: The public repository contains the MIT License covering the toolkit source.

complete_readme.rationale: Because this is an intentionally shared public proving-ground repository, the product-scoped toolkit document is the complete README surface: problem, use, components, manifest/action examples, security, recovery, accessibility, threat model, upstream positioning and limitations are all present.

beginner_start_here_path.rationale: A dedicated beginner/operator path explains when to use the toolkit, planning, publication, recovery, privacy and support without requiring implementation knowledge.

engineering_or_architecture_documentatio.rationale: The state machine, trust boundaries, manifest contract, least-privilege execution model, threat controls, exact-source rules and recovery semantics are documented.

recovery_or_rollback_guidance_for_mutati.rationale: The lifecycle defines no-mutation pre-draft failure, unpublished-draft recovery, post-publication incident handling and hard refusal to move/overwrite an existing public tag or release.

security_and_privacy_review.rationale: The public review covers least privilege, trusted-event/ref checks, no generic shell executor, no overwrite, secret non-retention, untrusted PR handling and privacy-safe issue intake.

known_limitations_documented.rationale: GitHub-only write backend, lack of version/changelog/package/binary-signing functions, permissions, language and conformance limits are explicit.

contribution_and_issue_paths.rationale: Public contribution guidance and a dedicated privacy-safe governed-release issue path exist.

canonical_handover_or_build_record_updat.rationale: The final public handover binds exact release source, real acceptance, retained artifact digests, red-team findings/fixes and scope limitations; public portfolio status is updated in the same reviewed completion tranche.
